Dear John Mitchell,

Please find attached the minutes of our recent client meeting. Here is a brief summary:

- Discussed your requirements for the new project.
- Agreed on the project timeline and key milestones.
- Reviewed initial design concepts and gathered your feedback.

Action Items:
- I will update the project plan based on your feedback.
- David Lee will coordinate with the development team to start the initial phase.

The next meeting is scheduled for 2024-06-01.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
